notes: Transactional self-update: the old version's backup is now temporary — once the new version is verified installed, the backup is deleted (no backup folders left behind); if anything in the update fails, the partial install is removed, the previous version is restored, and leftovers are cleaned up. Also includes folder-URL installs (0.8.0), always-present declaration files (0.7.0), the capabilities/connectors split (0.6.0), mechanical used_by id validation (0.5.1), side chat creation (0.4.0), mandatory integrity verification (0.3.1), the opt-in daily update check (0.3.0), and the Quality & Safety gate (0.2.0).
